summary: Job status is always current, commits no longer fail after a template import, and fewer policy changes wait for approval.

fixes.title: Jobs clear themselves when they recover
fixes.text: A job shows as failing only while its latest run failed. There is nothing to acknowledge, and Jobs, Overview and the menu count always agree.

fixes.title: Commit all works after a template import
fixes.text: Commits could fail after importing a template pack. Commit now runs once, and the import skips groups that already exist and tells you which.

fixes.title: Fewer policy approvals
fixes.text: A policy nobody has ever changed, such as one on a group you just created, gets its template without needing approval. Policies someone set are still held.

fixes.title: Temporary Access Pass lasts 8 hours
fixes.text: When no lifetime is set, a Temporary Access Pass lasts 8 hours, not 48 as the previous release said, and never longer than your tenant allows.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Defender XDR roles no longer show as changed on every run, error messages are clearer, template packs can be imported from Settings, and some labels were corrected.
